players.bio: Adam Marušić (Serbian Cyrillic: Адам Марушић, pronounced ; born 17 October 1992) is a Montenegrin footballer who plays as a right midfielder for Italian club S.S. Lazio and the Montenegro national team.

Alessio Romagnoli (born 12 January 1995) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Lazio and the Italy national team. Romagnoli began his career with Roma in 2012, and later spent a season on loan with Sampdoria in 2014, before moving to AC Milan in 2015.

Alfonso Pedraza Sag (born 9 April 1996) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Villarreal CF. Primilarly a winger, he can also operate as a left back. Formed at Villarreal, he went on to play as a senior for that club as well as Lugo, Leeds United, Alavés and Betis.
Andrea Pinamonti (born 19 May 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Italy national team.

Christos Mandas (Greek: Χρήστος Μανδάς; born 17 September 2001) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Lazio. On 28 November 2017, Mandas made his professional debut in Greek Cup against Sparta. On 30 September 2019, he signed a contract extension until the summer of 2022, with a buy-out clause of €2,000,000.
Danilho Raimundo Doekhi (born 30 June 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for German club Union Berlin as a centre back.
Danilo Cataldi (born 6 August 1994) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Lazio.
Davide Frattesi (born 22 September 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Lazio, on loan from Inter Milan, and the Italy national team.
Diogo Filipe Monteiro Pinto Leite (born 23 January 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Union Berlin as a central defender.

Edoardo Motta (born 13 January 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Lazio. Club career A youth product of ASD Soccer Spartera, Motta joined the youth academy of Juventus on 9 June 2016. He joined U17s of Alessandria on a season-long loan on 3 August 2021. On 20 June 2022, he went on a season-long loan to the Monza U18s.

Elseid Gëzim Hysaj (born 2 February 1994) is an Albanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Italian club Lazio and the Albania national team. Hysaj can operate on both sides of the pitch as a full-back.
Oluwafisayo Faruq "Fisayo" Dele-Bashiru (born 6 February 2001) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Lazio and the Nigeria national team.

Gustav Tang Isaksen (born 19 April 2001) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Lazio. After he signed his first professional contract in May 2019 – a five-year deal – he made his debut on 25 August 2019 in the Danish Superliga when he came on as a substitute for Awer Mabil in the 78th minute of the 2–0 away win over SønderjyskE.

Josip Šutalo (born 28 February 2000) is a professional footballer currently playing as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Croatia national team. Šutalo made his debut for Croatia national team on 10 June 2022 in a 1–0 victory over Denmark in the Nations League, having been named in the starting lineup.

Kenneth Ina Dorothea Taylor (born 16 May 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Lazio and the Netherlands national team. Taylor made his Eerste Divisie debut for Jong Ajax on 15 October 2018 in a game against Jong PSV as a 70th-minute substitute for Jasper ter Heide.

Luca Pellegrini (born 7 March 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a left back or left wing-back for Serie A club Lazio. Pellegrini made his debut with the Italy U21 team on 11 October 2018, in a friendly match lost 1–0 against Belgium. With the Italy U20 side he took part in the 2019 FIFA U-20 World Cup, in which Italy achieved a fourth–place finish.
Manuel Lazzari (born 29 November 1993) is an Italian footballer who plays as a right midfielder (his preferred position) or right-back for S.S. Lazio and the Italy national team.
Matteo Cancellieri (born 12 February 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger or second striker for Serie A club Lazio and the Italy national team.

Mattia Zaccagni (Italian pronunciation: ; born 16 June 1995) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or striker for Serie A side Lazio and the Italy national team. Zaccagni made his professional debut in the Lega Pro for Venezia on 10 September 2014 in a game against Südtirol.

Maurizio Sarri (Italian pronunciation: ; born 10 January 1959) is an Italian professional football manager. Sarri did not play football professionally, taking part as an amateur centre back and coach while working as a banker. In 2005, he had his first Serie B job at Pescara.
Nicolò Rovella (born 4 December 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Lazio and the Italy national team.
Nuno Albertino Varela Tavares (born 26 January 2000) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Serie A club Lazio.
Oliver Provstgaard Nielsen (born 4 June 2003) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Lazio.

Patricio Gabarrón Gil (born 17 April 1993), known as Patric, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Italian club Lazio. Mainly a right-back, he can also operate as a defensive or central midfielder.

Pedro Eliezer Rodríguez Ledesma (born 28 July 1987), known as Pedro, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Serie A club Lazio . Pedro scored 99 goals in 320 appearances across all competitions for Barcelona from 2008 to 2015, before joining Chelsea in 2015. In 2020 Pedro joined Roma.
Reda Belahyane (born 1 June 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Lazio. Born in France, he plays for the Morocco national team.

Romano Benito Floriani Mussolini(born 27 January 2003),also referred to as Mussolini Jr. by Italian media, is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Serie A club Cremonese, on loan from Lazio. He is the son of politician Alessandra Mussolini, the grandson of pianist Romano Mussolini, and the great-grandson of the fascist dictator Benito Mussolini.
Samuel Florent Thomas Gigot (born 12 October 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back of full-back for Serie A club Lazio.

Tijjani Noslin (born 7 July 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Lazio. Club career Early years Born in Amsterdam, Noslin played for several clubs in his hometown, including ASV Arsenal, Buitenveldert and Swift, before moving to 's-Hertogenbosch at age 14 to join FC Den Bosch's academy.
